name: Offshore mooring chain (stud-link and studless, flash-butt welded)
description: Offshore mooring chain (stud-link and studless, flash-butt welded) named for mobile production unit service on a page read in the 20-year retrospective.

specifications.basis: LR Rules for the Manufacture, Testing and Certification of Materials, July 2022, Ch 10 Sec 3.1.1; scope covers offshore mooring of mobile offshore units and floating production units

specifications.metric: Grade R5 break test load at 60 mm nominal diameter
specifications.basis: LR Table 10.3.1 Test loads for mooring chain cables; last (R5 break test load) column at nominal diameter 60 mm

specifications.metric: grade range recognised by Intermoor/Acteon chain calculator
specifications.basis: Acteon blog published 18 August 2026 describing its Intermoor Mooring Chain Calculator; no numeric chain table was present on the page
